title: Sherpa-UI entity
description: One entity: a body saved under a type, an id and a name: its graph, or, for a type that keeps one, its query (a Filter's Where). The envelope is the same for every type; the type's own schema (entity-<type>.v1.json) says what its settings hold. Its use inside another graph is a node whose kind is "<type>:<id>". checkEntity() reads it. docs/history/plan-746-entities-and-graph-views.md

category.description: The category its node stands in, in the Nodes panel, as Runbooks. None: a node's settings', its type's, else Custom Nodes.

graph.description: Its graph, the one body every definition's is (defs.v1 graph). Inside, #in and #out are the entity's own sockets, as a Custom Node's.

query.description: In place of a graph, for a type whose graph part says `query: true` (a Filter): its Where, the one truth. Its lens draws its graph from it. One body, never both. Plan 960 U4.4b

settings.description: What the type keeps beside its graph; the type's own schema checks it.

uses.description: The entities its graph places, kept for a quick dependency check. The nodes are the truth.

versions.description: Its published versions, newest first (plan 972). Its label, words, body and settings are its working draft; a use and the node library read its newest version. A save never edits or drops one; a new id's first save publishes version 1.

at.description: When it was published: an ISO date and time.

by.description: Who published it: the app's current User where there is one, else free text.

note.description: Why: a Roll back says which version it brings back.

hash.description: Its definition's content hash: what tells a draft from it.

definition.description: What it keeps of the entity: its name, words, body and settings. Its tags and category file it, and are no part of a version.

origin.description: Set on read, never written: a preset is a file's and read only; the reader's own are mine.
